outcome: Bell's stage II or higher Necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC)
cohort: Very preterm infants born between 24+0 and 31+6 weeks of gestation to 27,660 women from the Chinese Neonatal Network.
finding: Maternal hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) were not significantly associated with the incidence of Bell's stage II or higher necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC), but were associated with a lower rate of NEC requiring surgical intervention.
